svg.aria-label: AI engineering — Claude, past autocomplete. How a feature actually gets built: I own the scope and the merge, the agents do the legwork in between. Me: scope · decide; Claude Code: plans, splits the work, with parallel subagents: explore (maps the codebase); build (test first, small slices); review (fresh context, fresh eyes); main: only what I understand. Context it starts with: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills/, memory/, MCP servers. Guardrails I keep: Evals against hand-written truth, Schema-validated output, The model reads, the code decides, I review every merge.
